title: Can ThreeJS handle a MMO?
author: kyrax80
selftext:
[](https://www.reddit.com/r/threejs/?f=flair_name%3A%22Help%22)

Out of curiosity I tried to port an old MMO which I used to play alot, Last Chaos, to web using Codex (I hope not many AI haters here). I did it just for fun. But when I tried to test the performance with 100 characters atacking 100 mobs with particles, animiation, etc. FPS drop to 20-30 from 90.

I tried many stuff that GPT suggested or almost 2 days but nothing is working at all. So my question is if it's worth to keep trying or this will just be impossible. My PC isn't the bottleneck, it seems to be that Chrome is intesively using 1 thread only from my processor or something like that. My processor barely moves from 9% performance and same for my GPU.

Thanks!
